name: Cervical pillow

lead: A cervical pillow is shaped with a contoured curve or raised roll to support the natural curve of the neck during sleep. Materials include memory foam, latex and springs.
It is marketed for neck comfort and alignment, and in looksmaxxing circles as a minor help for posture and morning neck stiffness.

paras: The contour aims to keep the cervical spine closer to neutral and spread pressure. A 2021 meta-analysis of pillow trials found that spring and rubber pillows reduced neck pain, waking symptoms and disability and improved satisfaction in chronic neck pain, while shape and height influenced alignment more than filling.

Fit depends on sleep position and body build, so a pillow that suits one sleeper can hurt another. Evidence is modest and trials are of mixed quality; earlier reviews found too little evidence to conclude. A pillow does not correct daytime posture, and claims of changing posture or facial appearance are unsupported.
